description.zh:
监播室ID。
>可查看[CreateLiveStreamMonitor](~~2848129~~)接口返回参数值获取**MonitorId**。
description.en:
The ID of the monitoring session.

> The **MonitorId** is returned in the response of the [CreateLiveStreamMonitor](~~2848129~~) operation.

descriptions.zh:
通过创建监播室[CreateLiveStreamMonitor](~~2848129~~)接口返回参数获取**MonitorId**，再调用本接口删除监播室。
><notice>启动状态下的监播室不可以删除，删除时返回400报错。
></notice>
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Obtain the **MonitorId** from the response of the [CreateLiveStreamMonitor](~~2848129~~) operation. Then, call this operation to delete the monitoring session.

><notice>

You cannot delete a monitoring session that is running. Attempting to do so returns a 400 error.

></notice>

## QPS limits

This operation is limited to 10 queries per second (QPS) per account. Calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which can affect your business. To avoid interruptions to your business, make sure that you do not exceed this limit.
